newsitem.title: USA: COHR files for 1.9 million shares.
newsitem.headline: COHR files for 1.9 million shares.

text.p: COHR Inc said it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.9 million common shares.
Of the total, 1.5 million common will be sold by the company and 400,000 common sold by selling stockholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 6,082,000 common.

The company and stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 285,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Needham & Co Inc and Corwell Weedon & Co.

Proceeds will be used for the expansion of the company's business acquisition and opening of additional sites and for other general corporate purposes, including working capital and capital expenditures.

The Chatsworth, Calif., company is a national outsourcing service organization providing equipment servicing, group purchasing and other services and products to hospitals, integrated health systems and alternate site providers.
